releases.note: One slot per Revit release the front door can be ASKED to target (tools/frontdoor.py author --target-version N). A slot resolves ONLY when status is 'certified' AND sha256 is pinned AND rvt.versions.KNOWN_RELEASES[N].creation_certified is True -- three agreeing sources, never fewer. A pending slot exists so the 2025 product path is visible and honestly refusable, not invisible.

resolution_order: the explicit --base PATH argument (user-supplied; refused if it is an Autodesk sample; hash NOT pinned, provenance ledgered instead)
$RVT_GENESIS_BASE environment variable (a firm's own certified base)
the pinned repo path experiments/genesis/subst_k4/compose/G_ABPD.rvt (sha256 must match the pin)
<plugin-root>/lib/genesis/G_ABPD.rvt if a packager bundles it (sha256 must match the pin)

policy.note: A base that fails the hash pin is refused as the DEFAULT (the pin is what makes 'certified genesis base' true). An explicit --base is accepted on the user's authority but recorded, provenance-ledgered and never asserted certified.
